episodeTitle.en: Why experts writing AI evals is creating the fastest-growing companies in history | Brendan Foody
episodeTitle.zh: 为何AI评估专家正在创造史上增长最快的公司 | 布伦丹·福迪

guestBioOfficial.en: Brendan Foody is the CEO and co-founder of Mercor, the fastest-growing company in history to go from $1M to $500M in revenue (in just 17 months!). At 22, he is also the youngest American unicorn founder ever. Mercor works with 6 of the Magnificent 7 and all top 5 AI labs to help them hire experts to create evaluations and training data that improve their models. In this conversation, Brendan explains why evals have become the critical bottleneck for AI progress, how he discovered this massive opportunity, and what the future of work might look like in an AI-driven economy. _Big thank you to Peter Deng for introducing me to Brendan._
guestBioOfficial.zh: 布伦丹·福迪是Mercor公司的首席执行官兼联合创始人，Mercor是史上增长最快的公司之一，从100万美元营收增长至5亿美元（仅用17个月！）。22岁的他也是美国最年轻的独角兽创始人。Mercor与Magnificent 7中的6家公司以及所有前5名的AI实验室合作，帮助他们聘请专家创建评估和训练数据以改进模型。在本次对话中，布伦丹解释了为何评估已成为AI进步的关键瓶颈，他是如何发现这一巨大机遇的，以及AI驱动的经济中未来的工作可能是什么样子。 _非常感谢邓鹏向我介绍布伦丹。_

title.en: Why experts writing AI evals is creating the fastest-growing companies in history | Brendan Foody
title.zh: 为何AI评估专家正在创造史上增长最快的公司 | 布伦丹·福迪

summary.en: Brendan explains the rise of “evals”—measuring model capabilities—as possibly the biggest business opportunity in history, with Mercor supplying extraordinary professionals to top AI labs. He covers what product-market fit looks like for this new category, the tenets that enabled such extreme growth, and what evaluators actually do day to day. The conversation also explores which skills and jobs will last longest with AI and why he doesn't expect AGI soon.
summary.zh: Brendan 解释了“评估”（evals，即衡量模型能力）的崛起——可能是史上最大的商业机会——Mercor 正为顶尖 AI 实验室提供顶尖专业人才。他讲述了这一新品类产品市场匹配的样子、支撑极端增长的原则，以及评估者每天实际在做什么。对话还探讨了在 AI 时代哪些技能和工作最持久，以及他为何不认为 AGI 会很快到来。
